dev.description: asva2 DEV stand: Kubernetes, Loki 2.6.1, read-only ingress
dev.hint: service takes a system name (listed at the end) or a helm release: ssj-main is the main branch of ССЖ, ssj-pr-1285 a PR stand (label instance). This stand has no applicationName or userId labels, and app is asv-app/sp-app for every Java service. One user's requests: text="\"userId\":\"11952\"" (the JSON field, set inside HTTP requests only). One task or error id across services: text="taskExecutionId=13548" or text="ERR-..." without service. Which config a service got: service="config-server", text="ssj-ui-backend". Stack trace lines of non-JSON services carry no level: after a level="error" line, read getLogContext with a selector without level. Loki 2.6.1: no detected_level.

tst.description: asva2 TST stand: docker-compose on the infra host, Loki 3.5, 7-day retention
tst.hint: Almost no traffic outside ССЖ and logs are kept 7 days: widen to start="now-6h" or "now-24h" before concluding that a service is silent. service takes a system name (listed at the end), a Spring service (ssj-backend; container nsi-connect logs as nsi-backend) or a container (label service: ssj-connect, config-server, nginx, kafka, keycloak). One user's requests: query {job="docker", userId="11952"} (HTTP requests only). One task or error id across services: text="taskExecutionId=13548" or text="ERR-..." without service. Which config a service got: service="config-server", text="ssj-ui-backend". Loki 3.5: | detected_level="error" covers more lines than level="error". Stack trace lines of non-JSON services carry no level: read getLogContext with a selector without level.
